items.title: Captain Verne Streckfus Interview, 1960-09-22
items.q: He played on the St. Paul for years... Dewey Jackson came down with a band from St. Louis... Dewey played on the Capitol.

ctx.x: What about Dewey Jackson? Do you remember him? Yeah, he played on the road.

He played on the St. Paul for years. He's now a porter up to Jeltson, I guess. He might have someone up there. He had been. I think he was working somewhere else. He just plays, he plays now a spot job. Pretty good partner player. He's come aboard, bring a band. He's been a band once in a while after a big Maribona. He's gone one or two seasons. And then, uh, Dewey Jackson came down with a band from St. Louis. But a good corner player himself, but, uh, not such a good organiser. But we had the best color band…
That's in St. Louis. That was in St. Louis.
